# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Around 10–12 years old when introduced, reaching his late teens/early twenties by Volume 4.
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** United States (raised in Boston, Massachusetts)
- **Role:** Student and writer

## Appearance

Paul is a handsome, sensitive-looking boy with a clear, expressive face and dark, soulful eyes. He has a refined, artistic air that distinguishes him from most of the other children in Avonlea. As he grows older, he retains his polished demeanor and striking, thoughtful looks.

## Personality

Paul is exceptionally imaginative, poetic, and sensitive, sharing a deep spiritual kinship with Anne Shirley. He populates his inner world with elaborate imaginary friends and tales, possessing a gentle and affectionate disposition. Highly dutiful and polite, he holds a deep reverence for beauty, art, and nature. Though somewhat reserved around strangers, he opens up warmly to those who understand his romantic perspective on life.

## Traits

- Highly imaginative and poetic
- Sensitive and emotionally deep
- Polite and affectionate
- Deeply loyal to loved ones

## Abilities

- Storytelling and creative writing
- Academic aptitude

## Goals

- To reunite his father with his former love, Miss Lavendar Lewis
- To pursue his creative and intellectual interests

## History

Paul Irving arrives in Avonlea as a young boy to live with his grandmother and attend the Avonlea school. Anne Shirley, taking up her first teaching position, quickly recognizes Paul as a 'kindred spirit' due to his vivid imagination and creative mind. Paul invents an intricate cast of imaginary companions, including 'rock people,' and shares his private stories with Anne. When his father, Stephen Irving, visits Avonlea, Paul unwittingly helps bridge the long-standing rift between Stephen and his old sweetheart, Miss Lavendar Lewis. Anne brings Stephen to Miss Lavendar's cottage at Echo Lodge, leading to their reconciliation and marriage. Following the wedding, Paul leaves Avonlea to live with his father and stepmother, though he maintains a loving correspondence with Anne as he continues his education and matures into a talented young man.

## Background by volume

- Born to Stephen Irving and his late wife in the United States.
- Raised largely by his grandmother, Mrs. Irving, in Boston after his mother's death.
- Sent to stay with his grandmother at the Irving homestead in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island.

## Affiliations

- Avonlea School — Student

## Relationships

### Stephen Irving

- Child of — Paul's father, with whom he shares a loving relationship.

### Lavendar Lewis (Irving)

- Child of — Paul's stepmother, whom he affectionately adopts into his life.

### Mrs. Irving

- Relative of — Paul's grandmother who helped raise him in Avonlea.

- Friend of — Paul's favorite schoolteacher and close kindred spirit.
